issues.where: crop A, beneath the lit limb where the globe meets the near rings
issues.what: A short, abrupt diagonal cutoff continues below the globe into the near-ring texture, making the overlap look like a compositing seam.
issues.fix: Separate near- and far-ring occlusion at the globe silhouette and keep the near-ring texture continuous through the crossing.

issues.where: crops T and V–X, nearest ring bands
issues.what: Fine grain repeats at much the same scale across neighboring bands, and long, uniformly stretched grooves give the foreground a brushed rather than particulate texture.
issues.fix: Vary particle scale and density between bands, break up the long streaks along the arcs, and filter the tightest grooves at output resolution.

issues.where: crop V, lower-left edge of the bright ring bordering the dark gap
issues.what: A fuzzy gray wedge interrupts the otherwise dark gap and cuts across the fine ringlets instead of following their arcs.
issues.fix: Remove the localized spill from the gap or constrain it to the ring geometry if it is intended as scattering.

issues.where: crop L, the bright globe just inside the lower-left limb
issues.what: The brightest cloud bands lose most of their fine contrast and soften into an airbrushed cream patch.
issues.fix: Roll off the highlights more gently and preserve subtle cloud-band contrast in the illuminated limb.
